item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q002_mazg_hise_remote_homology","answer":"SCOPe 2.08 supports remote homology—probable common ancestry—between these domains at the superfamily level. d1vmga_ (sunid 113676) belongs to the MazG-like family a.204.1.2 (116993), whereas d1y6xa1 (sunid 122676; residues A:7–93) belongs to the HisE-like (PRA-PH) family a.204.1.4 (140797). Both families belong to the all-alpha NTP pyrophosphatases superfamily a.204.1 (101386), within fold a.204 (101385) and class a, All alpha proteins. Their shared superfamily supports an evolutionary relationship beyond structural resemblance alone; their distinct families do not establish close homology or orthology. Fold or class membership alone would not establish common ancestry.\n\nThis classification does not justify transferring exact substrate specificity, catalytic efficiency, physiological role, or pathway membership between them. In particular, it does not establish that d1vmga_ performs HisE's phosphoribosyl-ATP pyrophosphatase reaction in histidine biosynthesis, or that d1y6xa1 has MazG-like broad nucleotide specificity or nucleotide-pool maintenance functions. SCOPe labels the d1vmga_ protein as hypothetical protein SSo12199 (SSo3215), reinforcing that the family name is not experimental functional validation. Shared ancestry makes conserved pyrophosphate-hydrolysis chemistry a reasonable hypothesis, but exact functional assignment requires independent active-site and ligand comparisons, biochemical substrate and activity measurements, and physiological or genetic evidence. Either domain may inform a structural comparison, but neither is automatically a reliable template for the other's substrate-binding details or an interchangeable functional representative.","evidence_used":["Pretrained knowledge of SCOPe hierarchy and limits of functional inference","/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1vmga_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1y6xa1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/113676","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/122676","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204.1.2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204.1.4","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116994","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140798","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116993","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140797"]}]}
